properties.name: spring.flyway-nc.enabled
properties.description: Whether to enable Flyway native-connectors auto-configuration.

properties.name: spring.flyway-nc.url
properties.description: Flyway native-connector URL (e.g. cassandra://host:port/keyspace, mongodb://host:port/db). Overrides any service-connection-supplied URL.

properties.name: spring.flyway-nc.user
properties.description: Username used to connect to the database.

properties.name: spring.flyway-nc.password
properties.description: Password used to connect to the database.

properties.name: spring.flyway-nc.default-schema
properties.description: Default schema (Cassandra keyspace / MongoDB database) appended to the URL path when the URL itself does not carry one.

properties.name: spring.flyway-nc.baseline-on-migrate
properties.description: Whether to automatically call baseline when migrating a non-empty schema.

properties.name: spring.flyway-nc.baseline-version
properties.description: Version to tag an existing schema with when executing baseline.

properties.name: spring.flyway-nc.validate-on-migrate
properties.description: Whether to automatically call validate when performing a migration.

properties.name: spring.flyway-nc.connect-retries
properties.description: Maximum number of retries when attempting to connect to the database.

properties.name: spring.flyway-nc.connect-retries-interval
properties.description: Maximum time between retries when attempting to connect to the database. If a duration suffix is not specified, seconds will be used.

properties.name: spring.flyway-nc.validate-migration-naming
properties.description: Whether to validate migrations and callbacks whose scripts do not obey the correct naming convention.

properties.name: spring.flyway-nc.fail-on-missing-locations
properties.description: Whether to fail if a location of migration scripts doesn't exist.

properties.name: spring.flyway-nc.target
properties.description: Target version up to which migrations should be considered.

properties.name: spring.flyway-nc.table
properties.description: Name of the schema history table that will be used by Flyway.

properties.name: spring.flyway-nc.create-schemas
properties.description: Whether Flyway should attempt to create the schemas specified in the schemas property.

properties.name: spring.flyway-nc.out-of-order
properties.description: Whether to allow migrations to be run out of order.

properties.name: spring.flyway-nc.migration-suffixes
properties.description: Migration file suffixes Flyway recognizes. Replaces Flyway's defaults rather than adding to them. When empty, the active database starter applies its own default (Cassandra: .cql; MongoDB: .js/.json), otherwise Flyway's default (.sql) applies.
